0022600135.text: The 76ers (3-1, 1st in the Atlantic) visit the Indiana Pacers (2-1, 6th in the East) for their fifth game of the season, coming off a loss after winning their previous three. Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti, Dominick Barlow, and Tacko Fall, while Jabari Walker, Joel Embiid, and VJ Edgecombe are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions. Indiana is missing Andrew Nembhard, Ben Sheppard, Ivica Zubac, Johnny Furphy, and T.J. McConnell, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27. The 76ers won all four meetings in 2025-26, including a 105-94 win in Indianapolis on April 10.
